summary: Nexa Resources S.A., a Luxembourg-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, furnishing interim CEO and CFO certifications (Form 52-109F2) related to its quarterly earnings release for the period ended June 30, 2026. The filing contains routine Sarbanes-Oxley-style certifications regarding the accuracy and completeness of interim financial reports and disclosure controls, relying on Canadian securities exemptions. No special-situation event—merger, tender, restructuring, or management change—is described; the interim CEO certification is standard regulatory compliance for periodic reporting. This is a routine current report, not a special situation.
